metadata.name: HP2NET code-discovery target knowledge
metadata.purpose: Describe supported tools and interfaces with format specifications for dynamic discovery.
metadata.policy: Before generating code, inspect parsl_workflow.py and compare its apps.* call sequence with the requested workflow implementation pattern.

nexus_alignment.description: Input sequence alignments in NEXUS format.

phylip_alignment.description: Input sequence alignments in PHYLIP format for RAxML or IQ-TREE.

mrbayes_trees.description: Posterior tree samples generated by MrBayes per gene.

mbsum_summary.description: Summarized tree files produced by mbsum.

bucky_prune_file.description: Translation and prune file for selected quartets.

bucky_raw_output.description: Raw concordance analysis outputs produced by BUCKy.

concordance_table.description: Unified concordance factor table for quartets.

quartet_input.description: Formatted quartet set with numeric IDs for Quartet MaxCut.

quartet_tree.description: Species tree inferred by Quartet MaxCut with numeric IDs.

named_quartet_tree.description: Quartet MaxCut tree with taxon names restored.

raw_gene_trees.description: Unified file containing the best unrooted trees for all genes.

rooted_gene_trees.description: Gene trees rooted using an outgroup.

phylonet_nexus.description: Structured NEXUS file with gene trees and InferNetwork_MP commands.

mrbayes.call_hint: Discover alignments with datalist = glob.glob(os.path.join(basedir['dir'], 'input', 'nexus', '*.nex')). Initialize ret_mbsum = []. Open a loop over input_file in datalist. Inside it, {out} = apps.mrbayes(basedir=basedir, config=config, input_file=input_file, inputs={in}).

mbsum.call_hint: Inside the same loop as apps.mrbayes, append apps.mbsum(basedir=basedir, config=config, input_file=input_file, inputs={in}) to {out}. After the loop, {out} is the result.

setup_bucky_data.call_hint: {out} = apps.setup_bucky_data(basedir=basedir, config=config, inputs={in}), then call wait_for_all([{out}]).

bucky.call_hint: Discover prune files with prune_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(basedir['dir'], 'bucky', '*.txt')). Initialize {out} = []. For each prune_tree in prune_files, append apps.bucky(basedir=basedir, config=config, prune_file=prune_tree, inputs={in}) to {out}.

raxml.call_hint: Discover alignments with datalist = glob.glob(os.path.join(basedir['dir'], 'input', 'phylip', '*.phy')). Initialize {out} = []. For each input_file in datalist, append apps.raxml(basedir=basedir, config=config, inputs={in}, input_file=input_file) to {out}.

iqtree.call_hint: Discover alignments with datalist = glob.glob(os.path.join(basedir['dir'], 'input', 'phylip', '*.phy')). Initialize {out} = []. For each input_file in datalist, append apps.iqtree(basedir=basedir, config=config, inputs={in}, input_file=input_file) to {out}.

setup_phylonet_data.call_hint: Compute out_dir = os.path.join(basedir['dir'], config.phylonet_dir). Initialize ret_phylonet = []. Open a loop over h in config.phylonet_hmax. Inside it, {out} = apps.setup_phylonet_data(basedir=basedir, config=config, hmax=h, inputs={in}).

phylonet.call_hint: Inside the same loop, with the same h, build filename = os.path.join(out_dir, basedir['tree_method'] + '_' + h + '_' + config.phylonet_input), then append apps.phylonet(basedir=basedir, config=config, input_file=filename, inputs={in}) to {out}. After the loop, {out} is the result.

snaq.call_hint: Initialize {out} = []. For each h in config.snaq_hmax, append apps.snaq(basedir=basedir, config=config, hmax=h, inputs={in}) to {out}.

ASTRAL.description: Species tree inference from gene trees

BUCKy.description: Bayesian concordance analysis of gene trees

Quartet MaxCut.description: Constructs species trees and quartet topologies from concordance factors

SNaQ.description: Infers phylogenetic networks using maximum pseudo-likelihood
